newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves via term system rps.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves via term system rps.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add reserves to the banking system via system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

"The funds rate closed out late at nine percent (on Monday) after a few banks came up short," said analysts at MMS International. Citing "lingering pressures" on Tuesday, the MMS analysts said they expected the Fed to add reserves to the banking system through either two-day or nine-day system repurchase agreements.
At 0946 EDT/1346 GMT, Federal funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
